investigations.family: chargecloud / LadeVerbundPlus 2026 migration / QR anonymous ad-hoc
investigations.evidenceSummary: Reopened because the September 2026 LadeVerbundPlus migration is genuinely new evidence: new B2C app de.ladeverbundplus.b2c, solid GmbH as central contract partner, chargecloud-backed platform, while anonymous ad-hoc remains explicitly separate and is initiated per charge point through QR/short URL chrg.me/CODE without registration. Current first-party partner pages prove that anonymous ad-hoc is not a single network-wide tariff after the migration. Examples effective/current in September-October 2026 include Stadtwerke Roth 0.70 EUR/kWh AC and 0.85 EUR/kWh DC; Stadtwerke Neumarkt 0.70/0.85; infra fuerth 0.6188 EUR/kWh for AC/DC<=50kW and 0.8144 EUR/kWh for DC>50kW; Stadtwerke Stein 0.6188/0.8144; Stadtwerke Ebermannstadt, Lauf and Weissenburg approximately 0.62/0.82. Blocking rules also differ in first-party partner material (e.g. 5 ct/min vs 10 ct/min AC and 45 vs 60 min DC thresholds). Therefore registered-app tariffs 0.55 AC / 0.68 DC cannot be substituted for anonymous ad-hoc and no global solid tariff may be inferred.
investigations.coverage: New 2026 app/backend architecture identified; anonymous QR flow semantics confirmed; multiple current first-party partner tariff families sampled across AC/DC and blocking components; full ~1439-point denominator not tariff-closed.
investigations.exactGap: Resolve anonymous_ad_hoc at operator/subnetwork or EVSE level from QR/chargecloud surfaces. Build deterministic partner-to-tariff groups only where current first-party evidence closes every relevant class/exception; otherwise retain per-EVSE fail-closed. Revalidate the canonical denominator before any promotion. Do not use registered LadeVerbundPlus/partner/eMSP tariffs as direct anonymous prices.
